description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 19.11.2018 to 25.11.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new legal rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, and formally rescinds a previous notification. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements, fitting the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
